items.title: National Biodiversity Authority releases Rs. 15.52 crore ABS Proceeds from Mustard Genetic Resources
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change National Biodiversity Authority releases Rs. 15.52 crore ABS Proceeds from Mustard Genetic Resources Amount to be shared among 26 State Biodiversity Boards and 3 Union Territory Biodiversity Councils based on Mustard cultivation area Posted On: 13 AUG 2026 8:44AM by PIB Delhi The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) has …
